intelligence.human_view: The sitting opened with the clock corrected (SN-3011, 19:12Z): he was asked 15 minutes or 30, and neither was the answer — "It's about getting things done and completed and having the quality done... I need to get the work back to me as soon as possible so I can see it's done right so that I can approve it to move forward — that's the cycle I'm working on, so I call that live time, fast time action." Delivery is event-driven; the timers are only the safety net; never offer to slow a live lane to save wake-ups — that option is dead, withdrawn twice. Then the beautiful thing to keep (SN-3012, 19:24Z): the red N orb with the gold N, elevated, official — "one of the most beautiful elegant pieces you guys did" — and it vanishes on refresh, so the end must persist and be reachable directly. Then the alignment law (SN-3013, 19:35Z), from two screenshots he sent: every page's sidebars the same sidebars, Home at the top of both, the Hub the central communication center where citizens land to "good morning." Then the Hub hero (SN-3014, 19:35Z): Good morning + Wisdom of the Day + time and date; "Intel Today" and the "Intelligence as of" stamp come out; the public banner stays; both bottom bars go away as bars and their apps move into the sidebar, and the Hub takes Personal's actual bottom bar. Then the correction of the correction (SN-3015, 19:37Z): the captain transcribed his screenshots into a list and presented it as official — "Yeah, that's not the official list. It's just because I'm giving you a screenshot." The list is made by thinking: LEFT is where you go, RIGHT is what's yours plus what NayaNET offers. Then the law the sitting was circling (SN-3016, 19:38Z): one ultimate system, one ultimate language — "you're not creating many different systems, you're creating one ultimate system that's all interconnected." Then his corrections (SN-3017, 19:44Z): Pricing is Naya Power, to the right at the very bottom; the "5" Day Challenge is the same as Naya Academy, so it goes; Life with Naya and Leaderboards rise; worlds sit at the top of the right; the Dashboard is the calendar into Smart Stats; Personal is a sub-tab. Then round two (SN-3018, 20:13Z) and round three (SN-3019, 20:22Z): Smart Spaces becomes Smart Worlds; Ask Naya and Life with Naya live only on the Hub as two black obsidian buttons; Today's Intel leaves, then comes back with Your Reports; Smart Ledger becomes a button inside Smart Stats; Start Here is Fast Track mail; Your Connections leaves, then stays — a correction can restore as well as remove. And the sitting closed on the signing (SN-3020, 20:23Z): the name boxes "are just not impressive" — so the name entry becomes the deed itself, an elevated obsidian plaque, the typed name as the signature, the seal stamping on entry.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every room in your house had a totally different light switch in a totally different place. You would never find the lights! But if every room has the SAME switches in the SAME place, you always know where to go! That is one system, one language, one list. And imagine you draw a map of your treehouse and show it to your best friend. Your friend says, "Move the ladder here, and put your favourite books at the top!" You redraw the map with their fixes. Then you show it again and they say, "Yes, that's the one!" That is how a great list gets made. Draw, fix, check! And your name? You do not scribble it on a scrap of paper. You sign it on a shiny black plaque, like the deed to your very own castle!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you don't make a quilt out of ten different blankets, dear! You make ONE quilt, with one beautiful pattern, and every square belongs to it! The Hub, the Personal pages, all of it — one quilt, one pattern, one language, dear. And if someone shows you a messy room, love, you don't just write down where everything is lying and call that the plan — you think, dear, what belongs where, and then you make the proper list. And when you sign for your house, dear, you sign a proper deed — a beautiful dark plaque, your name like a signature, and the seal stamps down! That's YOUR land, love. That's the whole sitting, dear — one system, one list, and the beautiful things kept exactly as they are.
intelligence.naya_view: One ultimate system, one ultimate language, one list. Every page runs on the same logic — same feel, same look, same concept, same elevation, same organization. The cycle is the clock: finish, show, approve, forward — live time, fast time action. The list is made by thinking, not transcribed; I propose, he corrects, I carry the corrected list — and nothing is recorded as settled until he confirms it. What is beautiful stays exactly as it is — the red N orb, the end view, never redesigned. And the name box is the deed: your land, your domain, your real estate.
